title: NanoGen pipeline parameters
description: Per-cell genotyping of targeted mutations from SCM-seq (10x scRNA-seq with targeted enrichment, Oxford Nanopore reads).

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Where the pipeline finds input data and saves output data.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV with columns sample, lane and fastq.
input.help_text: One row per sample and lane, with a header row `sample,lane,fastq`. Fastq paths must be absolute. Not a spec symbol.

outdir.help_text: Results are written under `<outdir>/<sample>/`. Use absolute paths on cloud storage. Not a spec symbol.

reference_options.title: Reference options
reference_options.description: Reference genome, its minimap2 index and the target file.

minimap2_input_genome.help_text: Used by minimap2 and by bam-readcount for the reference allele. Not a spec symbol.

minimap2_mindex.description: minimap2 index of the reference genome.
minimap2_mindex.help_text: A `.mmi` index built from `minimap2_input_genome`. Not a spec symbol.

bedfile.description: Tab-separated target file: chr, start, end, ref, alt, gene.
bedfile.help_text: One row per targeted mutation. Start and end are equal for SNVs. Not a spec symbol.

min_mapping_quality.description: Minimum mapping quality for a read to enter UMI grouping.
min_mapping_quality.help_text: Reads with MAPQ below this value are dropped before UMIs are grouped. Not a spec symbol: the spec assumes reads are confidently aligned. Units: Phred-scaled MAPQ.

consensus_options.title: Consensus
consensus_options.description: How each UMI cluster gets a consensus label (WT, MUT or OTH).
consensus_options.help_text: A label X is assigned iff count_X >= n_min usable reads and count_X / (r + a + o) >= f_min.

min_reads.description: Minimum usable reads supporting an allele to label a UMI cluster.
min_reads.help_text: Spec symbol n_min. A UMI cluster gets a consensus label only if the winning allele has at least n_min usable reads. Units: reads.

min_fraction.description: Minimum fraction of usable reads supporting an allele to label a UMI cluster.
min_fraction.help_text: Spec symbol f_min. The winning allele needs a fraction of at least f_min of r + a + o. Must be above 0.5 so that at most one allele qualifies. Units: fraction of reads, in (0.5, 1].

snv_min_base_quality.description: Minimum base quality for a read to count as usable at an SNV target.
snv_min_base_quality.help_text: Spec: the SNV base-quality threshold that defines a usable read (no symbol; 20 in the spec). Passed to bam-readcount `-b`. Units: Phred.

genotyping_options.title: Genotyping
genotyping_options.description: How cells are called MUT, WT or undetermined from their UMI labels.

error_floor.description: Lower bound on the per-target error rate used by the caller.
error_floor.help_text: Spec symbol ε (epsilon): P_s = max(q_hat, ε), so a target with no observed error is not modelled as error-free. Units: probability, in (0, 1).

blaze_options.title: BLAZE
blaze_options.description: Cell-barcode identification and demultiplexing with BLAZE.

blaze_expect_cells.description: Expected number of cells, passed to BLAZE `--expect-cells`.
blaze_expect_cells.help_text: BLAZE uses it to pick the cell-barcode whitelist from the barcode rank (knee) plot. Not a spec symbol. Units: cells.

blaze_edit_distance.description: Maximum edit distance for BLAZE to assign a read's cell barcode to a whitelisted one.
blaze_edit_distance.help_text: Passed to BLAZE `--max-edit-distance`. It corrects cell barcodes (CB), not UMIs. Not a spec symbol. Units: edits.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

container.description: Container image used by every process, referenced by digest.
container.help_text: Defaults to the pinned image built by `.github/workflows/docker.yml` from `docker/`. Override only to test a new image.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

validate_params.description: Validate parameters against the schema before the run starts.

show_hidden_params.help_text: By default, parameters set as _hidden_ in the schema are not shown on the command line when a user runs with `--help`. Specifying this option will tell the pipeline to show all parameters.

schema_ignore_params.description: Comma-separated parameter names to leave out of schema validation.
